Note.title: Note
Note.description: A user's note containing text, tags, and metadata.

userId.description: ID of the user who owns the note.

content.description: Main content of the note (Markdown/Rich Text).

tags.description: List of tags associated with the note.

isFavorite.description: Whether the note is marked as favorite.

isPinned.description: Whether the note is pinned to the top.

isArchived.description: Whether the note is in the archive.

isDeleted.description: Whether the note is in the trash.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the note was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the note was last updated.

summary.description: AI-generated summary of the note content.

lastActiveNoteId.description: ID of the last opened note.
